profile_description: Basketball | Dunking Performance Coach - LA Native, 6'4", Venice Basketball League player, World Champion 2017

videos.description: Dunk session with friends (@eyesonheight, @saucetommy). Multiple dunk types including vertical jumps, one-handed dunks, two-handed front dunks, reverse dunks, and alley-oop dunks. First dunk session of the year.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Excellent for extracting multiple dunk animations. Clear full-body movements visible. Good for vertical leap and arm extension captures.

videos.description: Dynamic running jump leading to a powerful one-handed slam dunk. Shows precise coordination, powerful leg drive, and upper body control.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Clean single dunk sequence. Ideal for capturing running approach to dunk animation. Clear leg drive and arm extension.

videos.description: Self alley-oop dunks performed at the Hoopbus. Multiple dunks from different angles around the mobile basketball hoop.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Self alley-oop is a unique movement - ball toss, jump, catch mid-air, and dunk. Great for special move animations.

videos.description: NBA All-Star Slam Dunk contest entry. Elijah Bonds performs a reverse dunk jumping over 3 crouched people. Includes dribble approach, explosive jump, mid-air rotation, and reverse jam.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Premium dunk contest footage. The reverse dunk over people is an elite-level animation. Capture the full sequence: approach, jump, rotation, dunk, landing, celebration.

videos.description: Quick dunk compilation showing multiple players performing dunks. Short clips of dunk attempts and successful dunks.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Very short clip. May be useful for quick dunk animation references but limited duration.

videos.description: Basketball practice session showing dribbling, jump shot, driving to basket, two-handed dunk, reverse dunk, behind-the-back pass, and a highlight windmill dunk.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Windmill dunk is a premium animation. Also good for basic basketball fundamentals: dribble, shoot, pass sequences.

videos.description: Gameplay footage showing lateral shuffles while dribbling, driving to the basket, multiple dunks, layups, and running to the basket. Features both offensive and defensive movements.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Great for gameplay animations - lateral movement, drives, and in-game dunks. More realistic game context than practice dunks.

videos.description: Casual basketball game footage featuring dribbling, passing, running, jumping, shooting, and dunking. Multiple players on court with fundamental basketball actions.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Good for general basketball gameplay animations. Multiple player interactions visible. Useful for team-based movement captures.

videos.description: Extended session featuring multiple slam dunks (one-handed, two-handed), basketball tricks with ground bounces, and various dunk styles. Longest individual video.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Longest video with most content. Multiple dunk variations and ball handling tricks. Good for extracting diverse animation clips.

videos.description: Desert Tour with The Hoop Bus - full 2v3 and 3v3 game footage. Features behind-the-back dribbles, crossover dribbles, aggressive drives, euro steps, layups, dunks, mid-range shots, jump shots, defensive stances, sprinting, and quick directional changes.
videos.motion_capture_notes: Most comprehensive gameplay footage. Contains the widest variety of basketball movements. Essential for capturing realistic game animations including offense, defense, and transitions.

track_and_field.note: Running and jumping movements from basketball videos can be repurposed for track & field sprinting and high jump animations

general_athletic.note: Lateral shuffles, quick direction changes, and agility movements can be repurposed for football, soccer, and other sports

tips: Trim videos to isolate individual movements before uploading to DeepMotion
For best results, select clips where the full body is visible and unobstructed
Side-angle shots work best for DeepMotion's 2D-to-3D motion capture
Process dunks separately from dribbling/shooting for cleaner animations
Use the celebration movements for victory/scoring animations in-game
